title: Guardrail Classifier Blind Spots vs the Model It Guards

original_idea.body: Pair an open guardrail classifier with an open chat model, categorize each jailbreak prompt by (guardrail catches?) x (model refuses?), and quantify marginal coverage vs correlated blind spots.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: marginal-coverage analysis is deployment-critical for defense-in-depth.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 2x2 categorization over a jailbreak suite, open components, no training.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-component deployment analysis for small actors, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Guardrail studies exist; marginal-overlap analysis may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Marginal coverage vs intrinsic refusals may not be standardly reported.
